name: Image Prompt Dialects
description: How each family of tag-trained image models reads a prompt: the tag grammar it expects, the blocks it is built from and in what order, and the vocabulary that acts on it. A model record names its dialect and a guide rule names the dialects it applies to, so a rule proven on one family is never handed to another. Add a family by adding a dialect here.

dialects.name: Illustrious and NoobAI
dialects.description: The SDXL-lineage checkpoints trained on Danbooru tags, and the NoobAI merges that add the e621 corpus to them. Trained around one megapixel, read as comma-separated tags, and steered by a rating term and a period term.
dialects.tag_separator: a comma followed by one space
dialects.multi_word_tags: Spaces and underscores read alike, with one exception: write a tag that contains a shorter tag with underscores, so that the whole tag binds and the inner one does not fire on its own.
dialects.artist_tag_form: the artist tag on its own, with no prefix, and only for an artist with about a hundred posts or more
block_order: figure count and any interaction between figures
the figure from head to toe

dialects.name: Anima
dialects.description: The Anima base models and the checkpoints built on them, which pair a Qwen-series text encoder and VAE with a Danbooru tag vocabulary. Trained around 1280 pixels square, they carry both the booru quality terms and the score bands, take a year term beside the period term, and want a higher explicit weight than the SDXL lineage.
dialects.tag_separator: a comma followed by one space
dialects.multi_word_tags: Spaces rather than underscores, except the score terms, which keep theirs.
dialects.artist_tag_form: the artist tag with an at sign in front of it
block_order: figure count and any interaction between figures
a plain-language line for what the tags cannot carry
